verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that Elastic serves an llms.txt at elastic.co (HTTP 200) whose description references observability solutions. Probes also confirm that the Observability docs are available as raw markdown (observability.md returns HTTP 200 with frontmatter), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs directly. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/markdown-docs offering for agents, evidence of how complete the llms.txt coverage of Observability docs is (it is company-wide rather than Observability-specific).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.elastic.co/llms.txt # Elastic

PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://www.elastic.co/docs/solutions/observability.md ---
